notes.title: Warplan Pacific Tour | Advancements and Unit Changes
notes.content:
The Warplan Pacific beta is coming to an end and we're getting closer and closer to release.

With that in mind, we have prepared the Warplan Pacific Tour, covering the main changes and improvements introduced in Warplan Pacific. The new series has a very special tour guide, as the videos are narrated by Alvaro Sousa, the developer of the Warplan series of games.

A new episode will be published on a weekly basis.

[h3]EPISODE #1 - Advancements and Unit Changes[/h3]

[previewyoutube=g3SW7e4psWg;full][/previewyoutube]

The first video covers changes in advancement that were based on player recommendations. It will also talk about unit differences between countries, the new marine unit ability, special country rules, and added events for China.

[url=https://www.matrixgames.com/game/warplan-pacific]Find out more.[/url]

notes.title: Warplan Pacific - first preview stream
notes.content:
Join us on [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch[/url][/b] this Thursday, March 11th, 4 PM GMT as [b]Alvaro Sousa[/b], developer of Warplan and Warplan Pacific, will be joining us for Tea Time. The first preview stream of Warplan Pacific with [b]Gamer_1745[/b] will follow.

[b]WHAT IS WARPLAN PACIFIC[/b]

WarPlan Pacific, announced back in December, uses the same game system as WarPlan Europe with additional features and improvements. The game covers all the nations at war in the Pacific theatre from December 1941 to 1945.

The game's scale is massive, covering [b]62 different potential countries [/b]on a map that measures 50 miles / 80km per hex. The game uses a modified Mercator map scaling to allow a flowing game that doesn’t overload the player. The [b]land scale[/b] is 15k - 60k men, [b]air scale[/b] is 300 - 400 aircraft and [b]naval scale[/b] is 1 capital ship and its support fleet.

[h3]WATCH THE REVEAL INTERVIEW[/h3]

https://youtu.be/Bi0yNsZZH4c

[url=https://www.matrixgames.com/game/warplan-pacific][b]Find out more.[/b][/url]

notes.title: WarPlan receives biggest update to date with Patch 1.00.8
notes.content:
Grand strategy wargame WarPlan, while not our favourite game in the entire world, is never-the-less a decent enough strategic simulation covering the European theatre of WW2. It was designed to try and incorporate over 50 years of board wargaming done by the developers, and is generally attempting to occupy a space somewhere between Strategic Command & a Gary Grigsby monster.

It's not made much of a splash since release but has got a positive rating on Steam. It has been quietly getting updates in the background, and the most recent Patch 1.00.8 represents the biggest content drop for WarPlan to date, and along with a whole host of changes it also includes a new scenario.

The new scenario is a smaller, more focused operational experience that covers the Axis push for Egypt during the North African campaign. You can choose to play as either the British or the Axis forces, and the developers feel this smaller game might help people practice interacting with the various operational elements of the game.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Warplan Update 1.00.08
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just made the latest version of Warplan available. Version 1.00.08 of Warplan is one of the biggest updates yet, bringing new content, fixes and changes for you to enjoy. Game rules were updated to make minor neutral powers align better with the relevant blocks when attacked, AI routines have been improved and various balance changes have been made to allow for more interesting play.

Most important however is the addition of the new [b]North Africa Scenario[/b]. In this scenario you can take control of either the British or Axis forces during the Axis push for Egypt. This is a smaller scenario, offering a great way to get some practice and providing its own operational challenges to solve. We would love for you to try it and let us know what you think. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2222301078

Users of the Matrix version can download the game using the ‘Check for Updates’ button on the launcher, or by downloading the latest patch from the Matrix Games Members area. For Steam users the game will be updated automatically.
